summary: INLIF Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice and proxy statement for an Extraordinary General Meeting on August 17, 2026. The meeting seeks shareholder approval for a share capital increase from $350,000 to $2.72 billion, a reduction of par value from $0.32 to $0.0001, adoption of amended articles, and ratification of auditors. These are routine capital structure adjustments, not a special situation. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. It is simply a routine corporate governance meeting notice.
